basic_info.description: Discover this charming Victorian home in Bernal Heights, offering a blend of historic allure and modern upgrades. Situated on a desirable block between Cortland Avenue and Holly Park, this property boasts a prime location with excellent walkability to Bernal's best amenities. The expansive 3218 sq ft lot features gorgeous mature landscaping and shed. Built pre-1900, the home exudes Victorian charm with thoughtful updates throughout. The main level includes 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, highlighted by a beautifully tiled fireplace, gleaming hardwood floors, and a restored Wedgewood stove. Enjoy East Bay views from the living room and Twin Peaks views from the kitchen. Additional features include a cedar closet, ample storage, and a deck off the kitchen. Upstairs, a versatile bonus space with a second deck offers 360-degree views. The lower level hosts a delightful 1 bedroom/1 bath garden living space. The property also includes a 1-car garage. This home presents a unique opportunity to own a piece of Bernal Heights history with modern conveniences and tremendous upside opportunity.
